"PH Roster Scheduling Plan"

"Overview"

• 3 PD and 3 DAY teams are scheduled for each Public Holiday. 
_*Prior to the August 2025 manpower expansion, the arrangement was 2 PD and 2 DAY teams. _
• Teams are balanced and PH duties are evenly distributed across all officers on a yearly basis.

"Scheduling Principles"

PH duties are scheduled with the following objectives in mind:

• No consecutive back-to-back PH assignments for the same officer.
• No duplicate PH assignments compared to the previous year, with the exception of racial holidays.

_PH scheduled duties follow the pattern below as much as possible:_

• _CP1, KG1, BU1, PJ1, WK1, CP2, KG2, BU2, PJ2, WK2, CP3, KG3, BU3, PJ3, WK3, CP4, KG4, BU4, PJ4, CP4, KG4, BU4, PJ4, BU5_

The pattern repeats once a full cycle (i.e.: BU5) is completed. See the Exceptions section below for scenarios where the pattern may not be followed.

"Exceptions"

There are several scenarios where exceptions to the standard pattern are made.

"1. Festive Seasons"

_For Hari Raya:_
• 2 DAY teams will be formed by non-Muslim officers (e.g. Officer-10 & Officer-04, Officer-25 & Officer-09).
• 3 PD and 1 DAY teams will be formed by balloting to ensure fairness, excluding officers who worked the previous year's Hari Raya.

_For CNY:_
• 3 PD and 3 DAY teams will be formed by non-Chinese officers.
• Chinese officers will not be scheduled to work on CNY, as they will be scheduled to work on Hari Raya instead.

_For Deepavali:_
• 3 PD and 3 DAY teams will be formed by non-Hindu officers.
• Hindu officers will not be scheduled to work on Deepavali, as they will be scheduled to work on Hari Raya instead.

"2. Work Exigencies"

For forecasted rainfall of more than 15mm, the HRW activation and extension SOP will be activated.

"3. OIL (Off In Lieu)"

• The PH Roster follows a non-shift schedule. 
• When a PH falls on a Sunday, the following Monday becomes a fixed OIL day and will be scheduled as a PH OIL — this is not to be confused with shift OIL leave. 

From 31 May 2026 onwards:
• Fixed OIL day will follow the previous Sunday's Target Roster.
• All shift officers will be granted OIL leave* for PH duties. "This OIL leave replaces PH pay." 

_*Key points to note:_
• OIL must be utilised within 6 months of it being granted.
• For officers on ES13 and below, OIL can be encashed once the 6-month utilisation window has lapsed.
• For officers above ES13, any unutilised OIL will be forfeited.
• Officers not scheduled to work on PH must apply their OIL accordingly.
